visualCharacteristics: Filtered content archive. A black 'Filters' pill reveals category chips; results render as a 2-column grid of light-grey card panels (blue/brand eyebrow label + bold title + 'Read more' link); a black 'Load more' pill reveals results in batches.
contentPattern: One setting row: 'Path' | folder(s) to list (comma-separated). Cards are generated from /query-index.json pages under the path, newest first: content-type eyebrow (from folder) + title + 'Read more' link. Filter chips come from each page's comma-separated keywords; batching and the Filters control are client-side behavior.
usage: 'Find something specific' style filterable, paginated content archive / resource listing.
